sub_site: non-cancerous breast tissue (uninvolved breast of breast cancer patients; reduction mammoplasty cohort)

evidence.quote: Breast tissue uninvolved by tumor was obtained on the day of surgery from women undergoing mastectomy
to target Eubacteria and Archaea, respectively, which cover the hypervariable region V4

controls.types: water negative control (not stated as sequenced)

evidence.quote: lab-grade diethyl pyrocarbonate–treated water is used as a negative control

notes: MSKCC cohort n=80 (20 per group) + reduction mammoplasty cohort n=126 samples from 63 women; A. muciniphila described as most prevalent species. Mouse experiments not extracted. Abstract says 'metagenomic sequencing' but methods describe 16S V4 (CosmosID).
